For the weapons in Dungeons, see MCD:Weapon.

A weapon is an item equipable in the melee or ranged slot used to deal damage to mobs.

Obtaining

Weapons are obtained by opening chests, defeating mobs (including Bosses and Powerful mobs), trading with a town merchant, or completing certain quests.

Effects

Main article: MCD2:Effects

All weapons come with a random effect that grants an additional property to the weapon augmenting a specific stat. Effects can be rerolled using echo shards at a blacksmith. Unique items have one effect that cannot be rerolled, but are stronger than average.

Power level

All weapons have power levels that affect their damage output. With a blacksmith, the power level of an item can be increased at the cost of emeralds. The power level of dropped and upgraded gear depends on the player's current hero level.

Melee weapons

Melee weapons are weapons that can be used to damage nearby mobs. They expend no resource upon being used, though have a limited range that puts the user in harm's way, leaving them open to swarms or easy targets for ranged enemies.

Combos

Each melee weapon has a sequence of attacks it follows when swung in short succession. The final attack in each combo deals the weapon's maximum damage. Though the last attack is often the slowest attack out of the combo.

Ranged weapons

Ranged weapons are weapons that can be used to damage mobs from a distance away.

Ranged attacks expend one arrow per use and cause the user to become stationary while firing. Unlike melee attacks, they can be done at any distance so long as the target is within line-of-sight and visible, making it the safer option for attacking. Attacking mobs from a distance can aggro them even while outside their targeting range, however.

Ammo

A hero's ammo counter displays above the artifact slots. Each ranged weapon has a different maximum ammo counter, and after not using the weapon for a short time, it begins recharging ammo on its own. Upon running out of ammo, the ranged weapon cannot be used until it recharges.

Bows

Bows are ranged weapons capable of being charged. They can be fired instantly to deal minimum damage, or the ranged attack button can be held down to charge up to a maximum damage shot before releasing. Arrows replenish over time, and players start with a maximum of eight arrows (this amount is directly altered by which bow and crossbow type you have equipped).

Enchanting

Main article: MCD2:Enchanting

All weapons can be enchanted or disenchanted at an enchantsmith, granting a bonus ability to a weapon. Each weapon can only hold one enchantment at a time, and enchantments can be upgraded up to two times to maximize their potency.

Trivia

  • The new ammo system for bows heavily resembles the bow system used in the Arcade edition of Minecraft Dungeons.
